sv.title: Flera utredningar mot Jensen Huang på gång – Trump-koppling kan granskas
sv.summary: USAs kongress förbereder flera utredningar mot techföretaget Nvidias grundare Jensen Huang, efter att han tagits tillbaka som VD för bolaget trots sin affär med en misstänkt kinesisk spion. Kongressen väntas också granska president Trumps ekonomiska kopplingar till Nvidia.

en.title: Several investigations into Jensen Huang in the works – Trump connection could be examined
en.summary: The US Congress is preparing several investigations into Nvidia founder Jensen Huang, after he was reinstated as CEO of the company despite his deal with a suspected Chinese spy. Congress is also expected to examine President Trump's financial ties to Nvidia.
